SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRMechModuleDef.label: Space Torpedoes
SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRMechModuleDef.description: These torpedoes are essentially massive, slow-moving missiles. They are equipped with far more powerful warheads and shield modulators, allowing them to pass safely through energy barriers.

SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRMechModuleDef.label: Armored Torpedoes
SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRMechModuleDef.description: Upgraded space torpedoes are fitted with armor, improving their survivability against enemy point-defense systems. On detonation, the torpedo's fragmented armor also inflicts additional damage.

SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRMechModuleDef.label: Devastator Torpedoes
SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRMechModuleDef.description: Advanced torpedoes equipped with ultra-powerful warheads. Featuring a sleeker design, faster engines, and improved shield modulators, they can easily pierce through energy barriers.

SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRMechModuleDef.label: Proton Launchers
SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRMechModuleDef.description: These energy projectiles consist of tightly clustered protons, capable of dealing massive damage to enemy hulls.

SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRMechModuleDef.label: Neutron Launchers
SD.GrayRace.Defs.GRMechModuleDef.description: Due to the devastating energy of neutrons, upgraded energy projectiles rely on neutrons rather than protons to strike the enemy.
